_comment: #514 L1: the combat bar's one-line readout keeps a line Skill's damage tag and its cooldown clause. A [Sharpshooter] L12 spars Relc; [Piercing Volley]'s readout is read ready (tag + 'Once every 2 rounds.'), then cast, then read cooling, where the live 'Recovering' clause leads and the effect is what the ellipsis eats. The slot-info payload is the HUD's composed line; the fitted on-screen text is pinned by tests/test_combat_readout_fit.gd and read here windowed.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Again? Fine. The dummies heal fast. Straw's forgiving that way. Same rules. Move and hit.

steps._comment: Bar: Attack 1, Dash 2, then the kit in order -- [Called Shot] 3, [Piercing Volley] 4, [Power Shot] 5, [Quick Nock] 6, [Piercing Shot] 7 ([Keen Eye] is passive).
steps.name: hotbar_4

steps._comment: READY: the description yields to the standing rule, and the short tag-first phrase leaves room for it.

payload_contains.text: [lb]Piercing Volley[rb] — 3 AP — weapon damage to all in a 5-cell line. Once every 2 rounds.

steps._comment: Line aim starts up; cycle down, left, right. (2,3) right reaches (3..7,3), so training_dummy_a at (7,3) is in the line.
steps.name: cycle

steps._comment: COOLING: the cost stamps the cooldown before the hit resolves, so the HUD re-renders first. The live clause leads after the cost; the effect phrase is what the ellipsis takes.

payload_contains.text: [lb]Piercing Volley[rb] — 3 AP — Recovering — ready in 2 rounds. — weapon damage to all in a 5-cell line
